## Green-paired application of the native vertex

In the adapted carrier, let J_s=[[0,I],[I,0]], J=-i rho J_s,
rho=N R^3, and N_h=[[0,0],[H_h,0]], H_h=i M_h for LR and RL.
The original collar law is S=I+alpha N_LR+beta N_RL, with independent
analytic row dual D=J S^-1 J^-1. Alpha and beta denote the two **unassigned**
normal monomials; neither is set to one as a physical value.

For a local factor vertex U, the original independent-left Green pairing
gives F(U)=J U-D J U S. Its coefficient for channel h is

    F_h=-J[U,N_h],       F_hh'=J N_h U N_h'=0.

The second identity is checked for all four channel pairs and every
consumed vertex. It follows from the lower triangular N_h and block
diagonal U, not a truncation or cancellation of unknown domains.

The v31 derivative-of-test vertex is V_a=-alpha_a G_Y/(R N).
The owned Clifford representation realizes V as diag(V_a,-V_a), and
the temporal insertion U_Y=-i G_Y/N as diag(U_Y,U_Y). Since
{alpha_a,M_h}=0 and [alpha_a,G_Y]=0, the selected block is

    F_time,raw = i R^3 [G_Y,M_h],
    F_a,raw    = -R^2 alpha_a [G_Y,M_h].

These are evaluated matrices, not a new abstract kernel accepting
unfilled data. The raw intrinsic normalized-normal-mode trace q is not

    F_time,cap = i[G_Y,M_h],
    F_a,cap    = -alpha_a[G_Y,M_h]/R.

This converts both independent trace densities and does not assign their
values. More generally the temporal coefficient is -C[U_Y,T_surface]B
when the owned trace/source intertwinings hold. Normal factors are then
in the actual left and right trace arguments, not silently omitted.
Only this proven paired cancellation is used.

For a real unit angular covector nu, alpha(nu) is unitary, so the spatial

## 1. New executed source coefficient

In the owned unit-S3 right-body frame the spatial principal of L is

    L^a = -i alpha^a/R4.

For a material temporal hypercharge test zeta(x), at fixed other fields,

    R_zeta = M_zeta U_R,  L_zeta = M_zeta U_L,
    U_R=z_cont G_Y/N_ind,  U_L=-z_cont G_Y/N_ind.

Differentiating P=LR on its factor core gives

    P_zeta = M_zeta U_L R + L M_zeta U_R,
    L M_zeta U_R = M_zeta L U_R + [L,M_zeta] U_R,
    coefficient_of(E_a zeta) = V^a=L^a U_R.                (1)

Derivatives of U_R stay in the zero-source-derivative part. This identity
does not license dropping the product domain contacts described below.

The new producer reads the saved 24 original matrices and theta22 directly;

    V^a = -alpha^a G_Y/(R4 N_ind),

For *any* real unit material edge covector nu, Clifford and charge algebra

    V(nu)^dagger V(nu) = diag(Delta^2 I12,4 Delta^2 I6)/(R4 N_ind)^2. (2)

Thus the derivative coefficient has rank18, with singular values

def _add(a, b):
    return {key: a[key] + b[key] for key in KEYS}


def _constant(matrix):
    matrix = np.asarray(matrix, complex)
    return {key: matrix.copy() if key == 'value' else np.zeros_like(matrix)
            for key in KEYS}


def two_collar_weak_domain_jets(*, plus_green, minus_green,
        geometric_right, geometric_right_inverse, geometric_left_dual,
        plus_normalized_trace, minus_normalized_trace,
        plus_canonical_source, minus_canonical_source,
        surface_kernel, left_chiral_projector):
    """Construct all value/x/y/xy domain rows on the two ORIGINAL traces.

    J_plus/minus are the original outward Green densities. The supplied
    geometric left dual pulls a minus canonical SOURCE COLUMN to the plus
    chart; on its real physical family it is U^dagger. A plus canonical
    row maps to the minus chart by right multiplication by this matrix.
    Its analytic source jets
    are independent, never inferred by conjugating source weights.
    Canonical source incidences already include the original Dirac-bar
    conversion once. T is the once-only rho*M18 surface kernel.

    All input shapes, inverse, Green-alignment, isotropy and original
    weak equations are checked or returned explicitly. Nonzero returned
    admission rows are not silently accepted as a physical domain.
    The jets are supplied total contacts on this chosen branch; the
    function does not produce the physical E/B/outgoing jets itself.
    """
    p0 = np.asarray(left_chiral_projector, complex)
    j0 = np.asarray(plus_green.get('value'), complex)
    if j0.ndim != 2 or j0.shape[0] != j0.shape[1] or not len(j0):
        raise ValueError('one nonempty full-fiber square plus Green map required')
    d = len(j0)
    if (p0.ndim != 2 or p0.shape[0] != p0.shape[1] or not len(p0)
            or not np.isfinite(p0).all()
            or np.max(abs(p0@p0-p0)) > 1e-12
            or np.max(abs(p0.conj().T-p0)) > 1e-12):
        raise ValueError('fixed Hermitian chiral projector required')
    n = len(p0)
    pl, pr = _constant(p0), _constant(np.eye(n)-p0)
    jp, jm, u, ui, us = (_jet(value, (d,d), name) for value, name in (
        (plus_green, 'plus_green'), (minus_green, 'minus_green'),
        (geometric_right, 'geometric_right'),
        (geometric_right_inverse, 'geometric_right_inverse'),
        (geometric_left_dual, 'geometric_left_dual')))
    bp, bm = (_jet(value, (n,d), name) for value, name in (
        (plus_normalized_trace, 'plus_normalized_trace'),
        (minus_normalized_trace, 'minus_normalized_trace')))
    cp, cm = (_jet(value, (d,n), name) for value, name in (
        (plus_canonical_source, 'plus_canonical_source'),
        (minus_canonical_source, 'minus_canonical_source')))
    t = _jet(surface_kernel, (n,n), 'surface_kernel')
    bl, br = _product(pl,bp), _product(pr,bm)
    b = _add(bl, _product(br,u))
    c = _add(_product(cp,pl), _product(_product(us,cm),pr))
    local = isotropic_seam_transfer_jets(jp,c,t,b)
    s, ns = local['transfer'], local['N']
    right = _product(u,s)
    left = _product(local['independent_dual_transfer'],us)
    identity = _identity(d)
    q = _add(bl,_product(br,right))
    weak = _difference(_product(jp,_difference(_product(ui,right),identity)),
                       _product(_product(c,t),q))
    graph = {key: np.vstack((identity[key],right[key])) for key in KEYS}
    rows = {key: np.hstack((-right[key],identity[key])) for key in KEYS}
    left_graph = {key: np.hstack((identity[key],left[key])) for key in KEYS}
    return dict(
        right_minus_from_plus=right, independent_left_minus_from_plus=left,
        original_two_trace_graph=graph, original_two_trace_domain_rows=rows,
        independent_left_two_trace_graph=left_graph,
        common_frame_transfer=s, common_frame_inverse_transfer=local['inverse_transfer'],
        common_frame_normalized_trace=b, common_frame_canonical_source=c,
        original_split_trace_on_graph=q,
        original_weak_surface_rows=weak,
        original_split_trace_rows=_difference(q,b),
        original_two_trace_domain_graph_rows=_product(rows,graph),
        original_two_trace_green_rows=_add(jp,_product(_product(left,jm),right)),
        geometric_green_alignment_rows=_add(jp,_product(_product(us,jm),u)),
        geometric_inverse_rows=_difference(_product(ui,u),identity),
        geometric_reverse_inverse_rows=_difference(_product(u,ui),identity),
        plus_selected_trace_jump_rows=_product(bl,ns),
        minus_selected_trace_jump_rows=_product(_product(br,u),ns),
        isotropy_rows=local['isotropy'], nilpotence_rows=local['nilpotence_rows'],
        original_free_graph_surface_defect=_product(_product(c,t),b),
        Higgs_left_left_rows=_product(_product(pl,t),pl),
        Higgs_right_right_rows=_product(_product(pr,t),pr),
        full_fiber_count=d, original_boundary_trace_count=2*d,
        graph_free_coordinates=d, selected_trace_count=n,
        additional_boundary_trace_copies=0, full_fiber_rows_deleted=0,
        fixed_source_coefficients_conjugated=False,
        geometric_dual_inferred_by_conjugating_jets=False,
        free_hard_trace_domain_retained_for_nonzero_surface_source=False,
        surface_kernel_copies=1, bulk_Higgs_mass_added=False,
        scope='original two-collar weak SH domain on supplied regular-wall jets',
        local_equations_returned_without_global_physical_admission=True,
        common_native_positive_domain_identified=False,
        physical_outgoing_energy_field_jets_evaluated=False,
        full_physical_derivative_gate_passed=False,
        original_coupled_corrections_applied=0,
    )

return radius


def lepton_current_hilbert_representation():
    """Eighteen Weyl components and their canonical positive current Gram.

    This counts the left weak doublet and right charged singlet in all three
    families.  It is a point fiber, not an angular or temporal truncation.
    The neutral left component remains present for a general Higgs doublet.
    """
    rep = retained_higgs_spin_charge_representation()
    gamma = rep['gamma_LR']
    alpha = np.array([gamma[0]@gamma[a] for a in range(1, 4)])
    full_alpha = []
    for item in alpha:
        result = np.zeros((18, 18), complex)
        result[:12, :12] = np.kron(np.eye(6), item[:2, :2])
        result[12:, 12:] = np.kron(np.eye(3), item[2:, 2:])
        full_alpha.append(result)
    gamma5 = np.diag(np.r_[-np.ones(12), np.ones(6)]).astype(complex)
    charge = np.diag(np.r_[np.zeros(6), -np.ones(12)]).astype(complex)
    return dict(alpha=np.array(full_alpha), gamma5=gamma5,
        Gram=np.eye(18, dtype=complex), EM_charge=charge,
        Higgs_EM_charge=np.diag([1., 0.]).astype(complex),
        family_Y=np.asarray(rep['family_yukawa']), frame_order=FRAME_ORDER,
        positive_current='j_normal=psi_dagger psi; chi=R4^(3/2)psi; Haar Gram identity',
        round_spatial_Dhat='-i sigma^a E_a+3/2',
        factor_massless_W='diag(-Dhat_S3,+Dhat_S3)/R4 on the appropriate Weyl copies',
        angular_or_temporal_cutoff_selected=False,
        CAR_state_selected=False, full_stratified_statistics_lift=False)


def fixed_y_higgs_hamiltonian(H):
    """Hermitian LR Hamiltonian mass map for a GENERAL complex H doublet.

    V_(a,f,s;g,t)=H_a Y_(f,g) delta_(s,t).  The reverse vertex is V^dagger.
    Values use the same H units as the represented proper-clock operator.
    No Higgs axis, profile, magnitude or independent Yukawa is selected.
    """
    h = _finite(H, 'H')
    if h.ndim != 2 or h.shape[1] != 2 or not len(h):
        raise ValueError('H needs (points,2) from the coupled scalar map')
    y = lepton_current_hilbert_representation()['family_Y']
    v = np.einsum('pa,fg,st->pafsgt', h, y, np.eye(2)).reshape(len(h), 12, 6)
    result = np.zeros((len(h), 18, 18), complex)
    result[:, :12, 12:] = v
    result[:, 12:, :12] = v.conj().transpose(0, 2, 1)
    return result

def combine_executed_fermion_pair(direct,mean):
    """Combine the reached Y2 terms, with Gamma_F=+Tr E1/2 exactly once.

    The source Hessian is complex-bilinear on real source directions.  No
    transpose, conjugation, source-pair doubling or charge-conjugate copy is
    inserted.  The three direct pieces are separately retained.
    """
    required=('source_square_contact','ordered_two_insertion','opposite_order_two_insertion')
    arrays={k:np.asarray(direct[k]) for k in required}
    m=np.asarray(mean)
    if m.shape!=(8,8) or any(a.shape!=(8,8) for a in arrays.values()):
        raise ValueError('all64 same-source direct and mean entries required')
    if not np.isfinite(m).all() or any(not np.isfinite(a).all() for a in arrays.values()):
        raise ValueError('finite executed direct and mean pairings required')
    direct_total=arrays[required[0]]+arrays[required[1]]+arrays[required[2]]
    ungraded=direct_total+m
    return dict(**arrays,direct_source_pair=direct_total,induced_mean_operator_contact=m,
        ungraded_source_pair=ungraded,fermion_statistics_factor=COMPLEX_FERMION_STATISTICS_FACTOR,
        graded_source_pair=COMPLEX_FERMION_STATISTICS_FACTOR*ungraded,
        complex_fermion_copy_count=1,charge_conjugate_doubling_applied=False,
        both_source_orders_retained=True,mean_contact_count=1,
        complete_relative_native_or_Pauli=False)


def actual_finite_core_overlap_moment(fields,representation,angular,raw_mean_load,
        chronological_jacobian,chronological_step,*,length,frame='temporal'):
    """Evaluate the first short-heat source coefficient, rather than subtract it.

    On this SAME finite core, Tr_0 exp(-sP)=6-s Tr_0 P+O(s²).
    The leading rank6 coefficient has no source variation, and the entire
    Y-independent operator, source and induced mean map are identical in
    the two family copies.  Their relative contraction is exactly zero.
    The Y2 term is not central: its direct Xi-dagger Xi and actual induced
    mean variation of Tr P2 are evaluated below and generally survive.

    This is the finite-core Taylor moment, NOT a continuum a2/a4 heat
    coefficient.  Thus no M8/M5/M4 local action is subtracted from it.
    """
    polynomial=actual_cell_heat_polynomial(fields['raw_fields'],representation,length=length)
    from .muon_primal_cell_reached_source_heat import actual_reached_cell_vertices
    from .muon_native_mean_core_heat_target import _unit_lepton_mass6
    from .muon_native_dirac_hamiltonian import lepton_current_hilbert_representation
    source=actual_reached_cell_vertices(fields,representation)
    if fields['profile']!=0 or fields['profile_rate']!=0 or np.any(fields['first_wall_gauge']):
        raise ValueError('same derived zero midpoint wall trace required')
    H=source['complex_H_response']
    X=np.array([_unit_lepton_mass6(h) for h in H.reshape(160,2)]).reshape(8,20,6,6)
    Y=np.diag(lepton_current_hilbert_representation()['family_Y']).real
    dy=Y[1]**2-Y[2]**2
    gram=np.einsum('Ahij,Bhij->AB',X.conj(),X)
    direct=dy*(gram+gram.T)
    target=dy*np.trace(polynomial['P2_raw_first_jet'],axis1=1,axis2=2).real
    induced=contract_phase_native_target(chronological_jacobian,representation,chronological_step,
        target,raw_mean_load,frame=frame)
    mean=induced['native_mean_response_pair'];complete=direct+mean
    return dict(common_family_central_mixed_overlap=np.zeros((8,8)),
        leading_rank_coefficient_source_mixed_variation=np.zeros((8,8)),
        paired_TrP_Y2_direct_contact=direct,paired_TrP_Y2_raw_target=target,
        paired_TrP_Y2_mean_contact=mean,paired_TrP_Y2_complete_contact=complete,
        paired_first_short_heat_coefficient=-COMPLEX_FERMION_STATISTICS_FACTOR*complete,
        mean_application=induced,
        central_cancellation_equation='Gamma0[background,source,domain]-Gamma0[background,source,domain]=0, including the SAME raw mean chain rule',
        first_short_heat_equation='delta_AB Tr0 exp(-sP)=-s delta_AB Tr0 P+O(s²); rank6 term has zero source variation',
        first_short_heat_coefficient_scope='finite normalized tent/constant-angular C6 trace only; not continuum a2/a4',

        physical_overlap_or_soft_Pauli_completion=False)

},
